= Quoted label substitutions
:label: Expanded
:escaped: \"quote\"
:source-highlighter: syntect

link:https://example.org["One {escaped} two",role=green]

pass:a,m[link:https://example.org["{label} \"quote\"",role=green\]]

pass:m,a[link:https://example.org["{label} \"quote\"",role=green\]]

pass:q,m[link:https://example.org["*Bold \"quote\" label*",role=green\]]

[source,text,subs=+macros]
----
link:https://example.org["One \"quote\" two",role=green]
https://example.net["One \"quote\" two",role=green]
mailto:test@example.org["One \"quote\" two",role=green]
----

[subs=macros]
link:https://example.org["One \"quote\" \] two",role=green]

[subs=-macros]
link:https://example.org["One \"quote\" two",role=green]

----
link:https://example.org["One \"quote\" two",role=green]
----

pass:m,a,q[link:https://example.org["Label ((One \"quote\")) footnote:late[Note \"quote\".\] tail",role=green\]]

Reuse footnote:late[].

:whole: "One"
:equals: =

pass:a,m[link:https://example.org["One {escaped}",role=green\]]

pass:m,a[link:https://example.org["One {escaped}",role=green\]]

pass:a,m[link:https://example.org[{whole},role=green\]]

pass:m,a[link:https://example.org[{whole},role=green\]]

pass:a,m[link:https://example.org["a{equals}b"\]]
